description.en: Health and Safety Compliance
General H&S Compliance
Contractors must comply with all relevant H & S legislation.

Measures must be taken to minimize any risk to the public. For example, tools must not be left on the pavement where they could present a trip hazard. Any motor vehicle or plant machinery used must be parked so as not to contravene any parking restrictions and/or present any obstruction to other road users and the public.

The Contractor must adhere to the relevant codes of practice and regulations. In particular, the erection, testing and maintenance of the installation must be carried out in accordance with the latest Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) and undertaken by a competent person as laid out in those regulations.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Provide H&S information prior to installation

description.en: The successful contractor will be expected to produce a Health & Safety Information prior to installation. This will include: Risk Assessment, Method Statement, Schedule of Works, Any other relevant documents such as General Health & Safety at Work Policy, accreditation certificates and staff training certificates.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Minimal disruption to traffic and environment

description.en: The work must be undertaken in a manner that causes little disruption to traffic both vehicular and pedestrian, as well as with consideration for the environment.
Insurance and Certification
Insurance and Certificates
It is a requirement that the contractor is adequately insured, with public liability cover. A copy of your current insurance certificate must be included in with tender response.

Tender Submission and Procedure
Tender Process

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Site visit prior to tender submission

description.en: It will be expected that the Contractor, prior to submitting a tender will have made any necessary site visits and satisfied their self of any access arrangements and any other necessary information required and that the tender is fully inclusive of all costs.
The contract will be awarded to the company that complies with all written requirements, has satisfactory references and offers the best value for money.
All invitations to tender are subject to the Town Council's Standing Order number 17 and the terms of the Bribery Act 2010.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: No contact with councillors outside process

description.en: No contractor shall contact councillors or staff to encourage or support their tender outside the prescribed process.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Submit tender in sealed marked envelope

description.en: Tenders are to be submitted in writing in a sealed marked envelope addressed to the Town Clerk. The envelope should be clearly marked 'Tender'.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Tenders opened after deadline by Clerk

description.en: Tenders shall be opened by the Town Clerk in the presence of at least two councillors after the deadline for submission of tenders has passed.

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Tenders considered at properly convened meeting

description.en: Tenders will be reported to and considered by the Town Council at a properly convened meeting.

Lighting and Decorative Installations
Lighting Operations
The lights must be in working order in good time, and no later than ONE WEEK PRIOR to the notified switch-on date of Saturday 28 November 2026.
Thereafter the lights need to be set to their automatic timers which result in their coming on at 4pm and going off at 10pm weekdays, and 4pm – 11pm weekends.
Maintenance and Call-Outs
Scheduled Maintenance
We require two scheduled run throughs of the display to check everything is functioning properly and to attend to any minor faults.
All lights and features are to be tested during down time and any minor work required such as replacing bulbs and fixing faulty connections is to be undertaken.
Call-Outs and Faults

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: All-inclusive call outs during festival period

description.en: The cost of all-inclusive call outs during the festival period for lights erected and maintenance checks

deliverableArray.bulletPoint: Call out within 24 hours for major faults

description.en: In addition, we require a call out within 24 hours for major faults including, but not limited to, complete failure of a motif or light string, extreme damage caused through vandalism, storms or road traffic accident.
Additional call out charges must be stated on the schedule.
The contractor will notify BTC immediately of any defective lights and features that require major repair at additional cost or that cannot be repaired so replacement can be considered in good time.
